parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
Specifies the type of the returned service source. If this parameter is not specified, service sources of all types are returned. Valid values:

- K8s: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) instance.

- MSE Nacos: MSE

- MSE ZooKeeper: MSE\_ZK

- SAE: SAE

- EDAS: EDAS
